semiconductor_relevance: High — Yangzhou Sipuer Technology specializes in semiconductor equipment development, refurbishment, and technical services, making it a relevant player in the industry.
summary: Yangzhou Sipuer Technology Co., Ltd. is a technology company focused on the development and refurbishment of semiconductor equipment, offering customized solutions for cleaning, etching, and drying processes. They also provide technical services and parts sales, supporting various semiconductor manufacturing needs.
capabilities: Customization of manual, semi-automatic, and fully automatic wet etching and cleaning equipment
Refurbishment and sales of used semiconductor equipment such as spin dryers and lithography machines
Sales of AEPT IPA Dryer and M-Tek silicon wafer spin dryers
technical_expertise: Cleaning and drying equipment for semiconductor substrates

regional_presence.Taiwan: The Taiwan branch focuses on installation, commissioning, and technical support for used semiconductor equipment.
